name: proof-or-bluff-realdeal-cli
description: Headless Node CLI for the realDeal Compact contract. Drives every circuit end-to-end against a local Midnight stack (or pre-prod) using a seed-phrase wallet, so we can exercise the wiring without a browser. Shares the on-chain contract with the browser app at ../app/.
_versionNotes: LEDGER-9 MATRIX (Mainnet hard-forked to ledger 9 on 2026-11-06): midnight-js 5.0.0, @midnightntwrk/wallet-sdk 2.0.0, @midnightntwrk/ledger-v9 1.0.0, @midnight-ntwrk/compact-js 3.0.0, @midnight-ntwrk/compact-runtime 0.21.0 for Compact 0.36.0 (language 0.28). Stack: proof-server 9.0.0, indexer 4.4.101, node accepting ledger-v9 1.0.0 transactions. Node.js >= 22.12 required — every midnight-js 5.x and wallet-sdk 2.x package is ESM-only. The ledger-9 protocol packages moved to the @midnightntwrk scope (no hyphen); midnight-js-*, compact-js, compact-runtime and platform-js stay on @midnight-ntwrk. midnight-js-network-id is gone — network id now travels in providers.config. The ROOT package.json overrides pin one copy each of ledger-v9, onchain-runtime-v4 and platform-js: two copies of a WASM package fail `instanceof` checks across copies.
